summary.text: Barry Marcum is the Republican candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 34, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists a prior office on the West Virginia magistrate courts.

paragraphs.text: Marcum was a candidate in the May 8, 2018 Democratic primary for House of Delegates District 20, where he received 45.1% of the vote and lost to Nathan Brown.
In 2026 he won the Republican primary for District 34, defeating Braydan Goff, John White and James Harless with 322 of 885 votes (36.4%).
He faces Democrat Tara Sexton in the general election.
